title: Orbital Remnants: Important Systems
summary: Read the Orbital Remnants signals, states, and failure clues that matter in play.

blocks.title: What To Watch
blocks.body: Suit modules, sealant patches, oxygen cells, emergency rockets, shuttle items, and route vessels describe what kind of trip you are ready to survive.

blocks.title: Player Signals
blocks.body: Watch suit integrity, oxygen reserves, pressure exposure, shuttle or access state, emergency supplies, and whether the route still has a clean extraction plan.

blocks.title: Keep It Legible
blocks.body: A Orbital Remnants system is working when another player could look at the state, understand the next action, and avoid the obvious failure.

blocks.title: State Check
blocks.body: Use the system note to read the current state, then choose one action that answers it.
